description: Defines classes and interfaces related to lazy computation and lowering context in PyTorch's lazy backend, including Computation and LoweringContext classes.

classes.name: Computation
classes.description: Abstract class representing a computation in the lazy backend, with methods for retrieving parameter sizes, shapes, names, and result shape.

classes.name: LoweringContext
classes.description: Manages the state and process of lowering a computation graph in the lazy backend, including parameter management and building the computation.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of LoweringContext with different parameters.

methods.name: GetParametersData
methods.description: Retrieves tensor data associated with parameters.

methods.name: SetUpAlias
methods.description: Adds a new input/output alias (default implementation does nothing).

methods.name: CheckResultShape
methods.description: Checks if a parameter shape matches the expected result shape (default implementation returns false).

methods.name: AddResult
methods.description: Adds an output to the result tuple and returns its position.

methods.name: AddParameter
methods.description: Associates an output with an input parameter, used mainly for debugging.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Builds and returns the computation object capturing all operations.
